standard_prerequisites.name: The affine description of a blowing up by blowup algebras, with the exceptional divisor over the affine chart cut out by the image of the chosen element
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives one direction immediately and supplies the description of the blowup algebra used to define the comparison map.

standard_prerequisites.name: The universal property of blowing up, cited from the same chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Upgrades the ring homomorphism built from the local divisibility into a morphism over the blowing up, which exhibits the point inside the affine chart.

core_obligations: One direction: over the affine chart defined by the chosen element the exceptional divisor is cut out by the image of that element, so a point of the chart has the stated property (proof lines 8480-8483).

Local divisibility: assuming the image of the element cuts out the exceptional divisor at the point, use that every element of the ideal maps into the ideal defining the exceptional divisor over the preimage of the affine open to write each element of every power of the ideal as a unique multiple of the corresponding power of the chosen element in the local ring at the point, the uniqueness coming from the element being a nonzerodivisor there (proof lines 8483-8492).

Build the comparison map: using the description of blowup algebras send the quotient of an element by the chosen power to that multiplier, and observe that the uniqueness noted above makes this a well defined homomorphism of algebras over the coordinate ring (proof lines 8493-8499).

Conclude via the universal property: the resulting morphism from the spectrum of the local ring to the affine chart is a morphism over the blowing up by its universal property, which means exactly that the point lies in that affine chart (proof lines 8499-8503).
proof_roadmap: Record the easy direction from the local description of the exceptional divisor (proof lines 8480-8483).

From the divisibility of elements of the ideal by the chosen element at the point, define the algebra homomorphism from the affine chart's coordinate ring into the local ring, and apply the universal property of blowing up to place the point in the chart (proof lines 8483-8503).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes membership of a point of a blowing up in the affine chart of a local equation by the condition that the image of that equation cuts out the exceptional divisor at the point (statement lines 8469-8478). The counted proof is short but has real content in one direction: assuming the equation cuts out the exceptional divisor, it shows that elements of the ideal become divisible by powers of that equation at the point, uses that the equation is a nonzerodivisor there to make the resulting multipliers unique, builds a homomorphism from the blowup algebra to the local ring, and applies the universal property of blowing up to obtain a morphism over the blowing up (proof lines 8480-8503). It is H2: the argument is carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being the affine description of blowups and their universal property.
